description: Bulk server operations from the Svelte 5 data grid: pick rows with checkboxes, choose approve, archive, re-assign or delete, and submit. A mock server processes the batch with a configurable concurrency of 1, 4 or 10, a live progress bar and a per-row outcome chip track queued, running, succeeded, failed and cancelled, and a Cancel button aborts in-flight requests and stops the queue without rolling back the rows that already succeeded.

faq.question: How is concurrency limited?
faq.answer: A small queue starts up to N requests at once and starts the next one as each settles, so a batch of 200 rows never opens 200 connections. The picker sets N.

faq.question: What does Cancel do to rows already done?
faq.answer: Nothing. Rows that succeeded keep their new status, in-flight requests are aborted and marked cancelled, and queued rows are never sent.

faq.question: How is the per-row outcome rendered?
faq.answer: A status column with a cell snippet reads an outcome map keyed by row id, so each row shows its own chip while the batch runs and after it finishes.
